build_iterative_webdataset: build a PyTorch IterableDataset that iterates over tar shards of images with JSON captions for distributed training
create_dataset_with_shard_sharding: create an IterativeWebDatasetWorldWide that shards tar files across distributed workers using global rank and worker ID
test_set_positions_resume: test the set_positions method to resume dataset iteration from a saved shard position for fault tolerance
review_shard_iteration_logic: review the _shard_iter method that yields shard IDs in a round-robin fashion across distributed workers
refactor_probability_filtering: refactor the __iter__ method to filter samples by language-specific entry probabilities loaded from numpy arrays
